text: {"us_status":"partial","label_product":"NUBEQA (darolutamide) tablets, for oral use","label_version_or_date":"Revised: 9/2026; FDA NDA 212099/S-016 label, Reference ID 5873203","label_section":"6.2 Postmarketing Experience","quote":"Skin and Subcutaneous Tissue Disorders: Angioedema (includes laryngeal edema, lip swelling, swelling face and swollen tongue)","eu":"EU PRAC adopted 11 Jun 2026 signal recommendation: update Nubeqa SmPC 4.8 and package leaflet to add angioedema under Skin/subcutaneous disorders, frequency not known, post-marketing.","uk":"UK MHRA/GB SmPC lists angioedema in section 4.8 as Not known under Skin and subcutaneous tissue disorders, with post-marketing footnote; emc last updated 17 Aug 2026.","us_regulator":"FDA public record: NDA 212099/S-016 supplement approval letter signed 22 Sep 2026 states the USPI was revised to include angioedema in Section 6.2; no separate FAERS potential-signals or Sentinel posting was found in the searched FDA pages.","sources":["https://dailymed.nlm.nih.gov/dailymed/drugInfo.cfm?setid=1a7cb212-56e4-4b9d-a73d-bfee7fe4735e","https://www.accessdata.fda.gov/drugsatfda_docs/label/2026/212099s016lbl.pdf","https://www.accessdata.fda.gov/drugsatfda_docs/appletter/2026/212099Orig1s016ltr.pdf","https://www.ema.europa.eu/sk/media/74502","https://www.ema.europa.eu/en/medicines/human/EPAR/nubeqa","https://www.gov.uk/guidance/find-product-information-about-medicines","https://www.medicines.org.uk/emc/product/11324/smpc"]}
